eyebrow: ServiceNow DevOps, Testing & Deployment · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 16 · Automated Test Framework (ATF)

code:
Employee submits request
   -> Manager approves/rejects
      -> Business Rule checks EquipmentAvailabilityChecker
         -> blocks a duplicate checkout
caption: The one sequence this application absolutely must keep working.

code:
Impersonate: employee  -> open request form -> set equipment
  -> submit -> verify state = "Pending Approval"
Impersonate: manager   -> open request -> set state = "Approved"
  -> submit -> verify state = "Approved"
caption: One Test, two real roles, through the real UI Policies.

code:
Create GlideRecord: request, state = "Checked Out"
Call: EquipmentAvailabilityChecker.isEquipmentAvailable(id)
Verify: returns false
caption: Validates the logic directly — no form, no UI Policy involved.
